summary: Your original thinking shows up through other people. You may encounter debaters, contrarians, or people who challenge how you think. Or you become the disruptive voice in the room.
body: Your original thinking shows up through other people. You may encounter debaters, contrarians, or people who challenge how you think. Or you become the disruptive voice in the room. The tension between your settled ideas and the shock of a new one plays out in conversation, where someone always seems to upend what you thought you knew. Those people are doing you a favor. The work is staying open to the better idea instead of digging in to win.
gift: At your best: open, sharp, sharpened by people who push back.
shadow: The trap: digging in to win instead of staying open to the better idea.
integration: Let thinking and speech and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
do: Stay open to the better idea
Hold your view loosely enough to upgrade it
dont: Treat every challenge as an attack
